title: The in-app assistant's shared shapes (API 1.44)
description: Not a message: what cmd.assistant.turn, evt.assistant.step and req.pipelines.assistant.memory share (plan 18, 22.3). The HTTP bodies in openapi.yaml (Assistant*) carry the same shapes. Ids of calls are `<thread_id>:<turn>:<n>`: the thread, its input counter, the call's index in that message (from 0), so a replay after a crash names the same call.

callId.description: <thread_id>:<turn>:<n>, n below 100 (the tool calls of one message; below 30 before API 1.56)

clientId.description: one drawer (a browser tab); a turn's actions run only in the tab that sent its message

screen.description: the screen summary the sending tab built from values it already works out (22.4), fenced as data. Studio refuses one over 16 000 characters of JSON (422)

ids.description: the open ids (session, workflow, version, pipeline, batch, row, sequence…)

hidden.description: the tab was hidden when it was built

actions.description: the actions this screen has registered now (the shell's included)

fields.description: the screen's own summary fields (22.4 table)

action.description: one screen action for the sending tab to run, in order; an action after a navigate is dropped

auto.description: from API 1.68 (Auto mode): runs by itself: a generation without its card, a safe save in its dialog; absent = false

asks.description: from API 1.68: Auto is on but this one still asks: the waiting line above its card

result.description: what one action did in the tab (or, for a tab that went away, did_not_run)

status.description: cancelled: Not now on its card, the dialog closed, or the screen unmounted; still_running: an await past its 10 min

result.description: done: what the action returned (a dialog's new id and @handle, an await's run, the new screen after a navigate)

error.description: failed, did_not_run: why (the form's own reason, `the tab was closed`)

line.description: one action line in the drawer

memory_id.description: a Remembered line: the item its Undo deletes

skill.description: from API 1.64: a Using skill line: the skill read

sources.description: a web search line: its sources, shown as text

card.description: a card the server asks (look_at, web_search, forget, Clear all); a screen action's card is drawn by its screen

kind.description: from API 1.61 plugin: a plugin tool with a risk flag asks first

note.description: what leaves the machine, or what can't be undone

tags.description: the tag line (`uses the GPU`, `sends to Brave`, `can't be undone`)

caps.description: used by this message so far (at most 40 model calls, 100 tool calls, 8 memory writes from API 1.56; were 12, 30, 4)

auto_takes_hour.description: from API 1.68: with Auto on, the takes Auto mode started for the user in the last hour

limits.description: the admin's caps per user (studio counts messages; pipelines counts model calls, tokens and look_at at the bound)

auto_takes_per_hour.description: from API 1.68: takes Auto mode may start for one user in an hour; absent = 8

auto_gpu_minutes_per_hour.description: from API 1.68: GPU minutes (the runs' estimates) Auto mode may start for one user in an hour; absent = 30

code.description: cap_message: a per-message cap ended the turn; cap_day, cap_tokens, cap_look_at: a per-user cap (the message is kept); answer: the model's answer failed its schema twice; provider: the model provider failed; off: the assistant or its provider is off

resets_at.description: a per-user cap: when it starts again

limit.description: a per-user cap: the cap it hit (calls or tokens a day, looks an hour)

memoryKind.description: the Memory list's Likes, Projects, Worked, Chats

thread_id.description: the chat that saved it (null once that chat is deleted)

shots.description: from API 1.69: a film's shot list (kind project only); `text` is then its summary, rewritten at each save_shots

shot.description: from API 1.69 (contracts/README.md, Assistant: shot list): one shot of a film's plan

n.description: the shot number, unique in its list

line.description: the line spoken (`@name: text`), if any

take_id.description: the take used for the shot, once picked

shotList.description: from API 1.69: a film's shot list, its shots by number ascending

film.description: the film's title; one list per title (any case) per owner
